name: viktranium-multi-affix-dc-ml34
note: ATOMIC multi-affix Viktranium craft, end to end, and LOAD-BEARING. Three spell schools at ML34, where every real Lamordia host is legendary-tier. The solve equips the Legendary Cataclysmic Buckler — an Off Hand host with TWO Weapon-category Lamordia slots — and crafts `Dolorous Focus (legendary)` (Equipment 8) and `Woeful: Exceptional Spell Focus Mastery` (Exceptional 2), each a single option carrying all seven school affixes, so two slots serve all three ranked schools. Explode those two options back into the pre-atomicity one-record-per-affix shape and the same query solves to Evocation 32 / Illusion 29 / Necromancy 28: a choice slot could take only ONE school's record, so the same two slots bought two schools instead of seven. The atomic shape is worth +2 Illusion and +2 Necromancy with no give anywhere — a strict improvement, not a re-ranking. That delta is the whole claim, and no ratified fixture showed it: endgame-necro-dc-ml34 ranks four schools yet did not move when atomicity landed, which is precisely why the newly-reachable path needed its own. tests/solver.test.js proves the shape at buildProgram level over a hand-built model — downstream of both the pool filter and the dominance pre-filter, so not the same evidence.

name: absorption-compound-crown-ml35
note: COMPOUND ABSORPTION expansion, end to end. The Legendary Crown of Ioun carries two compound enchantments — `Fire and Cold Absorption` and `Electricity and Acid Absorption` — which U5/U6 expand into four component affixes. Ranking `Fire Absorption` and `Electric Absorption` therefore has to read one component out of EACH compound off the same item. The Helmet is pinned because the Crown loses the slot on merit to Insight-typed rivals (Legendary Downcast Helm's Insight Fire 14 beats the Crown's Enhancement 40 once boots already supply Enhancement 37), so an unpinned query would leave the compound carrier out of the loadout and prove nothing about it. Pinned, both compounds are credited from the one worn item.

name: provenance-alias-sacred-dc-ml34
note: PROVENANCE LABEL substitution, end to end. `aliasTargets` is resolved by the harness through the SAME dataset.js `buildPickerVocabulary` + `migratePriorities` pair the picker and the saved-character load path use, so this fixture solves what a player actually gets after typing the name the results print. Its A/B twin `provenance-components-sacred-dc-ml34` ranks the seven component stats directly in the declared order; the guard asserts the two solves are byte-identical, which is the real claim — the alias is a SUBSTITUTION into separate lexicographic ranks, never a fused objective term (the weighted-sum mode the Non-goals list declines). Ranking the literal label instead would score zero: no item carries an affix named `Sacred Spell Focus Mastery`.

name: absorption-sonic-flag-ml26
note: #254 -- the PER-ITEM Sonic flag, end to end. `Elemental Absorption` expands four-way or five-way depending on a per-item shard flag ({{Absorption|Elemental|N|yes}} vs without); the crown fixture exercises only the STATIC compounds, which expand unconditionally and never read the shard. This pins one shard-gated carrier of each kind: Golden Orb of Death (level 26) (sonic: true, five elements at 20) in Off Hand and War Wizard's Robes (sonic: false, four elements at 5) in Armor. The issue's suggested four-way twin, Archaic Device, shares the orb's Off Hand slot and cannot be co-pinned; the Robes are the four-way carrier that fits a second slot. Both are pinned because neither holds its slot on merit, and an absent carrier proves nothing about its expansion. Helmet, Cloak, and Necklace are locked EMPTY because they hold every other Sonic Absorption source at ML 26 (Malicia's Crown 30, Prismatic Cloak 26, Song-Chime Locket 26, Downcast Cowl/Mystic Cloak) -- unlocked, Malicia's Crown DOMINATES the orb's Enhancement 20 and the orb's Sonic goes zero-marginal, proving nothing (the U2 load-bearing rule). Locked, Sonic == 20 comes ENTIRELY from the orb's shard-gated expansion.
